gloss: base (of a triangle); bottom of society

definitions.explanation: The bottom side of a geometric figure, especially a triangle. A standard term in mathematics education.
The lowest level or foundation of a society, organization, or hierarchy. Can refer neutrally to the grassroots or foundation, or negatively to the bottom rung of society.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is a standard math term learned in school. Sense 2 can be neutral ({底辺|ていへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧, broaden the base/grassroots) or negative (⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{底辺|ていへん}, bottom of society). In recent internet slang, {底辺|ていへん} is sometimes used pejoratively to describe low-status jobs or lifestyles, which many consider offensive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {底辺|ていへん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧: length of the base
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{底辺|ていへん}: bottom of society
- {底辺|ていへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: broaden the base
- {底辺|ていへん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{這|は}い{上|あ}がる→這い上がる：06269_haiagaru⟧: climb up from the bottom
